instruction: A slender lanternfish arched in a crescent, its flank studded with rows of photophores burning aqua-white. The dark navy body is nearly matte so the emissive dots and the bulb dangling from a forehead filament dominate, casting cool light onto the fins. A soft volumetric glow bleeds off the tail tip and around each pinprick light organ.
